falling_cube.title: Falling Cube
falling_cube.note: Single free rigid body floor contact. Useful for detecting tiny contact drift after impact.

box_stack.title: Box Stack
box_stack.note: Twenty jittered boxes with many contacts. A compact stress case for ordering and reductions.

domino_chain.title: Domino Chain
domino_chain.note: Sequential impacts amplify small timing changes into visible propagation differences.

arm_7dof.title: 7-DOF Arm
arm_7dof.note: Franka arm tracks deterministic sinusoidal PD targets from a fixed base.

humanoid.title: Humanoid Standing
humanoid.note: Unitree H1 holds a standing pose; drift or falling exposes articulated-contact robustness issues.

diffsim_ball.title: Diffsim Ball
diffsim_ball.doc: Diffsim ball target gradient inspired by ``example_diffsim_ball``.
diffsim_ball.note: Differentiable particle target with wall and floor contacts; core includes loss and initial-velocity gradients.

diffsim_bear.title: Diffsim Bear
diffsim_bear.doc: Compact soft bear gradient inspired by ``example_diffsim_bear``.
diffsim_bear.note: Differentiable soft bear activation network; core includes the loss, COM velocity, and activation-weight gradients.

diffsim_cloth_com.title: Diffsim Cloth COM
diffsim_cloth_com.doc: Small cloth gradient scenario inspired by ``example_diffsim_cloth``.
diffsim_cloth_com.note: Small differentiable cloth target; COM uses an atomic accumulation before backpropagating gradients.

diffsim_soft_body.title: Diffsim Soft Body
diffsim_soft_body.doc: Small soft-body material gradient inspired by ``example_diffsim_soft_body``.
diffsim_soft_body.note: Small differentiable soft-body material target with dynamic soft contacts and material-parameter gradients.

diffsim_spring_cage.title: Diffsim Spring Cage
diffsim_spring_cage.note: Differentiable spring-cage target; core includes loss and spring rest-length gradients.

vbd_cloth_patch.title: VBD Cloth Patch
vbd_cloth_patch.doc: Pinned cloth patch evaluated with the VBD solver.
vbd_cloth_patch.note: Pinned cloth patch with ground contact, using VBD bending-aware coloring.

vbd_soft_body.title: VBD Soft Body
vbd_soft_body.doc: Pinned tetrahedral block evaluated with the VBD solver.
vbd_soft_body.note: Pinned tetrahedral block with ground contact, using VBD particle/tet solve paths.

warp_counter_indexed.title: Warp Indexed Counter
warp_counter_indexed.doc: Consumed-return ``atomic_add`` with a dynamic counter index.

warp_counter_sliced.title: Warp Sliced Counter
warp_counter_sliced.doc: Consumed-return ``atomic_add`` through a sliced per-world counter view.
